mapper.sql: id, name, description, status, progress, start_date, target_date, github_url, demo_url, problem_solved, tech_stack, cover_image, difficulty, solution, finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'PLANNED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id DESC

INSERT INTO project(user_id, name, description, status, progress, start_date, target_date, github_url, demo_url, problem_solved, tech_stack, cover_image, difficulty, solution, finished_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{project.name}, #{project.description}, COALESCE(#{project.status}, 'PLANNED'), COALESCE(#{project.progress}, 0), #{project.startDate}, #{project.targetDate}, #{project.githubUrl}, #{project.demoUrl}, #{project.problemSolved}, #{project.techStack}, #{project.coverImage}, #{project.difficulty}, #{project.solution}, #{project.finishedAt}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET name = #{project.name}, description = #{project.description}, status = #{project.status}, progress = #{project.progress}, start_date = #{project.startDate}, target_date = #{project.targetDate}, github_url = #{project.githubUrl}, demo_url = #{project.demoUrl}, problem_solved = #{project.problemSolved}, tech_stack = #{project.techStack}, cover_image = #{project.coverImage}, difficulty = #{project.difficulty}, solution = #{project.solution}, finished_at = #{project.finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{project.id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE project SET progress = #{progress}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, log_date, content, commit_ref FROM project_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC
